reason: A DSH watchdog that monitors agent activity, identifies genuine stalls while exempting in-flight work, records events, exposes local status, and nudges the agent through staged recovery messages without terminating tasks.

summaries.zh: 监控 DSH 智能体活动并识别真正卡顿，在豁免进行中操作的同时记录事件、提供本地状态查询并发送分级恢复提示。
summaries.en: Monitors DSH agent activity to detect genuine stalls, record events, provide local status information, and send staged recovery prompts while exempting in-flight operations.

capabilities: Monitors agent and session activity events
Detects prolonged silence when no in-flight operation is present
Injects diagnostic, repair, and redirection messages into stalled sessions
Writes JSONL event records to local storage
Exposes a loopback HTTP status route
